exposure: Cesarean section using the Misgav-Ladach method
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean section using the Misgav-Ladach method at the Clinic for Gynecology and Obstetrics, University Clinical Center Tuzla, between January 1, 2019 and December 31, 2019
finding: The prevalence of SSI following cesarean section was high (5.28%), with Enterococcus faecalis and Escherichia coli being the most common pathogens isolated
